nodes.label: DB Migration Policy (no destructive fallback)
nodes.rationale: fallbackToDestructiveMigration removed so upgrades never wipe users' reports; every schema change needs an explicit Migration. MIGRATION_1_2 verified on emulator upgrading from 0.1.0.

nodes.label: Git Bash JAVA_HOME / MSYS_NO_PATHCONV gotcha
nodes.rationale: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 (needed for adb device paths) stops path conversion, so JAVA_HOME must be in Windows form or gradlew.bat fails.
